g.text: - Sensor outputs: black line = LOW. GPIO 34-39 are input-only pins, used only for the sensors.

g.desc: - Sensor outputs: black line = LOW. GPIO 34-39 are input-only pins, used only for the sensors.

g.text: - Each side has two motors in parallel (4-wheel skid steering). Onboard LED on GPIO 2 mirrors the status LED.

g.desc: - Each side has two motors in parallel (4-wheel skid steering). Onboard LED on GPIO 2 mirrors the status LED.

g.text: - All grounds are joined (supply, L298N, ESP32, sensor). The 1000 uF capacitor smooths motor current spikes.

g.desc: - All grounds are joined (supply, L298N, ESP32, sensor). The 1000 uF capacitor smooths motor current spikes.

g.text: - ENA/ENB jumpers removed: speed is PWM from GPIO 25 / 26. GPIO 13 is not used (damaged on our board).

g.desc: - ENA/ENB jumpers removed: speed is PWM from GPIO 25 / 26. GPIO 13 is not used (damaged on our board).

g.text: - The 12 V supply powers the L298N motor driver; the L298N 5 V regulator powers the ESP32 (VIN).

g.desc: - The 12 V supply powers the L298N motor driver; the L298N 5 V regulator powers the ESP32 (VIN).
